_comment: Central school directory consumed by the Teacher Codex mobile app's onboarding/bootstrap flow. The app fetches this file from https://directory.teachercodex.app/schools.json, lets the teacher pick their school by name/code, then cross-checks the entry against the school's own /.well-known/teacher-codex.json before storing the API base + cert pins.

schools.name: Codex Demo School
schools._comment: Sandbox instance (deploy/containers/): app-store reviewers + teacher training. Fictitious data only. Sign-in = OTP_REVIEW_PHONE/CODE from that server's settings.json.
